title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Placing the Included Mileage on a Rental
content:
A rental of the Car Rental Rate Classes that carries a counted mileage allowance has that allowance placed on it as included mileage, so that the rental's own allowance stands at a figure of miles and the renter can be told how far the hire lets them drive on the miles the class includes. The result this basis governs is the miles included on that rental; the observable effect is a single grant standing on the rental's allowance.

**The action the desk takes.** The desk credits the rental with one grant covering the whole hire, at the figure of miles it has worked out from the published terms of the Car Rental Rate Classes and the rental's own records.

**How the tool is reached.** The tool `grant_included_mileage_444a2a24` is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it. One call credits the rental with a single grant covering the whole hire at the figure supplied, so the rental's included allowance stands at that many miles once the grant is placed.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `drive_rental_id` | The reference number of the car rental agreement the allowance belongs to, as it stands on the rental record returned by the car rental lookup | An identifier |
| `miles_granted` | The included miles placed on the rental, negative when miles are consumed | A whole number of miles, so a grant is stated as a positive integer with no decimal part, no thousands separator and no unit written after it |

**Return.** The call comes back with a confirmation sentence naming the reference of the mileage grant just placed, the rental agreement it was placed on and the whole number of included miles now standing on that rental's allowance. Any other text means the grant was not placed.
